sloka: आश्वास्य भरतं दीनं कौसल्यां च यशस्विनीम् ।कैकेयीं च सुमित्रां च दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमातरम् ।। ६.१२२.४ ।।
transliteration: āśvāsya bharataṁ dīnaṁ kausalyāṁ ca yaśasvinīm ।kaikeyīṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamātaram ।। 6.122.4 ।।

translations.english: "Comforting piteous Bharata, illustrious Kausalya and Kaikeyi too, seeing Lakshmana's mother Sumithra, and attaining sovereignty, make relatives happy. Establishing Ikshvaku race, conducting horse sacrifice and satisfying the Lord attain highest renown by giving wealth in charity to brahmins. You, who are endowed with mighty prowess, deserve to go to heaven", said Lord Maheswara.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने, इन्द्र के भेजे हुए दिव्य और अभ्नि के समान चमचसाते रथ को लोटा कर ले जाने के लिए मातलि को ध्याज्ञा दी और उसका सत्कार भो ।कअआ
